svg.title: Tool execution: validation, authorization and one deadline
svg.desc: Invalid input or rejected authorization never enters the handler. Registry and per-call authorizers must both allow execution. Timeout/cancellation stops waiting, but handlers must obey signal and external effects are not rolled back. handler values become data; resultHandler preserves HaiResult.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["tool.execute(input, options)"] B["Establish deadline and cancellation signal"] C["Validate input within remaining time"] D["Check configured registry and per-call authorization"] E["Run handler / resultHandler"] F["Return HaiResult; release timer and listeners"] X["Validation / authorization / cancellation / timeout failure"] A --> B B --> C C --> D D --> E E --> F C -->|"invalid input"| X D -->|"not allowed"| X E -->|"cancelled / timed out / thrown"| X X --> F classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class F good; class X stop;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
